The regex ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ was run against 1,001, 5,001, 20,001, 50,001 and 100,001-character inputs built to match the character classes and then fail at the last character, which is the shape that triggers catastrophic backtracking where it exists: 0.27, 0.04, 0.14, 0.40 and 0.46 milliseconds. Linear, not quadratic, because the mandatory hyphen between the two classes removes the ambiguity. The measurement is in the comment so the next reader need not repeat it.
